pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does it mean to say that God is the sole Creator? (1 mark)
   A. God was made by someone
   B. God had many helpers in creation
   C. God made only the animals
   D. God is the only Creator

2. According to Genesis 1:27, human beings were created in the what of God? (1 mark)
   A. Shadow
   B. Name only
   C. Voice only
   D. Image

3. Which is a result of a bad choice such as fighting? (1 mark)
   A. Getting a prize
   B. Injury and punishment
   C. Better marks
   D. More friends

4. You find a Ksh 100 note in the classroom. What is the right choice? (1 mark)
   A. Hide it
   B. Give it to the teacher to find the owner
   C. Spend it at the school shop
   D. Keep it quietly

5. Which question helps you to choose rightly? (1 mark)
   A. Who will laugh at me?
   B. Will I get away with it?
   C. Does this agree with what God teaches?
   D. What is the cheapest?

6. In a family tree, where are the grandparents normally placed? (1 mark)
   A. At the top
   B. At the bottom
   C. In the middle with the children
   D. Outside the tree

7. Who are your grandparents? (1 mark)
   A. Your uncles
   B. Your neighbours
   C. The parents of your mother or father
   D. Your brothers

8. How many books are in the Old Testament? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 66
   C. 27
   D. 39

9. How many books are in the New Testament? (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 39
   C. 27
   D. 21

10. What did Jesus say about why He came? (1 mark)
   A. To rule Rome
   B. To collect taxes
   C. To build a palace
   D. To seek and to save the lost

11. How much would Zacchaeus pay back to anyone he had cheated? (1 mark)
   A. Twice
   B. Four times the amount
   C. Ten times
   D. Half

12. How did the crowd react when Jesus went to Zacchaeus' house? (1 mark)
   A. They grumbled
   B. They followed Zacchaeus
   C. They were silent
   D. They cheered

13. What is a judge in the book of Judges? (1 mark)
   A. A leader raised up by God to rescue Israel
   B. A priest
   C. A court officer today
   D. A king

14. Which people ruled the Israelites during Samson's time? (1 mark)
   A. The Philistines
   B. The Egyptians
   C. The Greeks
   D. The Romans

15. Whom did Joseph credit for the interpretation? (1 mark)
   A. The magicians
   B. The cupbearer
   C. Himself
   D. God

16. What did Joseph advise Pharaoh to store during the good years? (1 mark)
   A. One fifth of the harvest
   B. Half the animals
   C. All the harvest
   D. Nothing

17. Who had the dreams about seven cows and seven heads of grain? (1 mark)
   A. Potiphar
   B. Jacob
   C. Joseph
   D. Pharaoh

18. How old was Abram when he left Haran? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 50
   C. 75
   D. 100

19. What is a patriarch? (1 mark)
   A. A king
   B. A prophet
   C. A soldier
   D. The father and leader of a family or nation

20. What kind of life did Zechariah and Elizabeth lead? (1 mark)
   A. Wicked
   B. Righteous before God
   C. Lazy
   D. Selfish

21. Who had died in the story? (1 mark)
   A. A soldier
   B. A king
   C. The only son of a widow
   D. A priest

22. To reconcile means to: (1 mark)
   A. Run away
   B. Shout
   C. Become friends again after a quarrel
   D. Fight

23. Who forgave his brothers who had sold him? (1 mark)
   A. Daniel
   B. Samson
   C. Joseph
   D. Balaam

24. Which of these is an emotional need? (1 mark)
   A. A new pair of shoes
   B. Someone to listen
   C. A meal
   D. A pencil

25. What is a parable? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A kind of coin
   C. A story with a meaning that teaches a lesson
   D. A song

26. Which value do we learn when we plant and water a seed? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Responsibility and patience
   C. Jealousy
   D. Greed

27. What is the mustard seed like in size? (1 mark)
   A. Very large
   B. Very small
   C. As big as an egg
   D. Medium

28. What does planting trees do for God's creation? (1 mark)
   A. Harms the soil
   B. Cares for the environment
   C. Kills birds
   D. Wastes water

29. A stranger offers you a lift. What should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Accept
   B. Say no and tell a trusted adult
   C. Go with them
   D. Give your name

30. What does obedience mean? (1 mark)
   A. Doing what you like
   B. Doing what those in authority say when it is good and right
   C. Refusing rules
   D. Arguing

31. Which commandment says "Honour your father and your mother"? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus 20:16
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Exodus 20:12
   D. Luke 1:37

32. Who was obedient to his parents at Nazareth? (1 mark)
   A. Samson
   B. Jesus
   C. Jonah
   D. Balaam

33. In which Gospel passage did Jesus bless little children? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 12:1
   B. Acts 2:1
   C. John 3:1
   D. Matthew 19:13-15

34. How should you care for an exercise book? (1 mark)
   A. Cover it and keep it clean
   B. Tear it
   C. Leave it in the rain
   D. Draw on it

35. Who ran away from a wrong situation and was wise? (1 mark)
   A. Joseph
   B. Zacchaeus
   C. Nicodemus
   D. Balaam

36. What did Jesus overturn in the temple? (1 mark)
   A. The windows
   B. Tables of the money changers
   C. The doors
   D. The altar

37. Who was Andrew's brother? (1 mark)
   A. John
   B. Thomas
   C. Philip
   D. Simon Peter

38. What does joy mean for a Christian? (1 mark)
   A. Only laughing
   B. Being rich
   C. Having no problems
   D. Deep gladness from knowing God

39. Which action shows self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting
   B. Waiting for your turn
   C. Pushing in a queue
   D. Taking others' things

40. Which of these is a digital device? (1 mark)
   A. A mobile phone
   B. A chair
   C. A pencil
   D. A stone

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Give three ways of showing respect to family members. (3 marks)

42. Explain how we can prevent the spread of contagious diseases and how we should treat those who are sick. (5 marks)

43. Describe four ways in which God shows that He is a loving Father. (4 marks)

44. Explain why Christians should help those in need. (3 marks)

45. Give two reasons why Zacchaeus climbed the sycamore-fig tree. (2 marks)

46. Describe how Abram showed obedience when God called him. (4 marks)

47. Explain how Genesis 1:27 and Psalm 139 help a child who feels unimportant. (5 marks)

48. Why did King Balak ask Balaam for help? (2 marks)

49. Explain what Proverbs 12:19 means. (3 marks)

50. Explain how John the Baptist prepared the way for Jesus and what we can learn about living righteously. (5 marks)

51. Describe how Zacchaeus met Jesus and how his behaviour changed. (4 marks)

52. State two promises that God made to Abram in Genesis 12:1-3. (2 marks)

53. Why were people with leprosy kept apart in Bible times? (2 marks)

54. State two lessons from the story of Stephen. (2 marks)

55. Describe three steps for saying no to temptation. (3 marks)

56. Describe how Mary responded to the angel's message. (3 marks)

57. Describe the naming of John. (4 marks)

58. Give two lessons from the story of Balaam and his donkey. (2 marks)

59. What did Pharaoh's two dreams mean? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — God is the only Creator
   Sole means only. God alone made everything.

2. D — Image
   Genesis 1:27 says that God created human beings in His own image.

3. B — Injury and punishment
   Fighting often brings pain, trouble and lost friendships.

4. B — Give it to the teacher to find the owner
   Honesty means returning what is not ours.

5. C — Does this agree with what God teaches?
   We measure choices by God's word.

6. A — At the top
   A family tree shows the oldest generation at the top.

7. C — The parents of your mother or father
   Grandparents are the mothers and fathers of your parents.

8. D — 39
   The Old Testament has 39 books.

9. C — 27
   The New Testament has 27 books.

10. D — To seek and to save the lost
   Luke 19:10 says that the Son of Man came to seek and save the lost.

11. B — Four times the amount
   He promised to pay back four times.

12. A — They grumbled
   Luke 19:7 says they all began to mutter.

13. A — A leader raised up by God to rescue Israel
   Judges were leaders who rescued Israel.

14. A — The Philistines
   The Philistines oppressed Israel in the days of Samson.

15. D — God
   Joseph said, "God will give Pharaoh the answer."

16. A — One fifth of the harvest
   Genesis 41:34 says to take a fifth.

17. D — Pharaoh
   Genesis 41 says that Pharaoh had the dreams.

18. C — 75
   Genesis 12:4 says he was seventy-five.

19. D — The father and leader of a family or nation
   Abraham, Isaac and Jacob are called patriarchs.

20. B — Righteous before God
   Luke 1:6 says both were righteous.

21. C — The only son of a widow
   The young man was her only son.

22. C — Become friends again after a quarrel
   Reconcile means to make peace.

23. C — Joseph
   Joseph forgave his brothers in Egypt.

24. B — Someone to listen
   Emotional needs include comfort and friendship.

25. C — A story with a meaning that teaches a lesson
   Jesus used parables to teach.

26. B — Responsibility and patience
   Caring for a plant teaches responsibility.

27. B — Very small
   It is one of the smallest seeds.

28. B — Cares for the environment
   Trees give shade, fruit and homes for birds.

29. B — Say no and tell a trusted adult
   Never go with strangers.

30. B — Doing what those in authority say when it is good and right
   Obedience means following good instructions.

31. C — Exodus 20:12
   Exodus 20:12 says to honour parents.

32. B — Jesus
   Luke 2:51 says Jesus was obedient.

33. D — Matthew 19:13-15
   Matthew 19:13-15 records it.

34. A — Cover it and keep it clean
   Covers protect books.

35. A — Joseph
   Joseph ran from temptation.

36. B — Tables of the money changers
   Matthew 21:12 says He overturned the tables.

37. D — Simon Peter
   Simon Peter and Andrew were brothers.

38. D — Deep gladness from knowing God
   Joy comes from God.

39. B — Waiting for your turn
   Waiting is self-control.

40. A — A mobile phone
   A phone is an electronic device.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Greet politely, obey, help with chores, speak kindly, share, pray for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 3.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands with soap, keep the environment clean, eat well, visit the clinic and follow the advice of health workers. We should treat the sick with care, kindness and respect and not reject them, as Jesus did.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hygiene, 1 for clean environment, 1 for clinic advice, 1 for kindness, 1 for not rejecting the sick.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: He gives life, food, water and air; gives families; forgives when we are sorry; knows us by name; sent Jesus to save us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus taught it; it shows love; it makes the community stronger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: He was short, the crowd was big, and he wanted to see Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: He left his country, his people and his father's household. He went to a land he did not know. He took his wife, nephew and belongings. He was seventy-five years old.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: Genesis 1:27 says people are made in God's image, so every person is valuable. Psalm 139 says we are fearfully and wonderfully made, so God took great care in making us. God also knows us by name. Therefore no child is unimportant, and we should respect ourselves and others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Genesis 1:27 meaning, 1 for Psalm 139 meaning, 1 for God knowing us by name, 1 for the conclusion, 1 for a clear link to the child's feelings.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: He was afraid of the Israelites and wanted them to be cursed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fear and 1 mark for wanting the Israelites cursed.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Truth lasts and is trusted, but lies are soon found out and do not last.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for truth lasting, 1 for lies not lasting, 1 for clear explanation.

50. (5 marks)
   Answer: John preached in the wilderness, called people to repent and baptised them, so their hearts were ready for Jesus. We can learn to turn away from sin, be honest and kind, pray, and tell others about Jesus by our example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for preaching, 1 for repentance, 1 for baptism or readiness, 1 for turning from sin, 1 for a righteous example.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: Zacchaeus climbed a tree to see Jesus. Jesus called him by name and went to his house. Zacchaeus promised to give half his goods to the poor and to repay four times anyone he had cheated.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for climbing the tree, 1 for Jesus calling him, 1 for giving to the poor, 1 for repaying.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: To make him a great nation, to bless him, to make his name great, and to bless all peoples through him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid promise.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: The disease was contagious and people feared it would spread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for disease and 1 for fear of spread.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: Be brave; forgive; trust God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, give a short reason, walk away, tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: She was troubled at first, asked how it could happen since she was a virgin, and then accepted, saying she was the Lord's servant.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for being troubled or asking, 1 for how, 1 for accepting.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: On the eighth day people wanted to call him Zechariah. Elizabeth said his name is John. They asked Zechariah, who wrote, "His name is John." His speech returned and he praised God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Obey God; do not be greedy; bless others; be kind to animals. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: Seven years of plenty followed by seven years of famine.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for plenty and 1 mark for famine.
